prompt: What is the name of the hotel that features over 7,000 rooms and one of the biggest casino gaming floors on the Las Vegas strip?
answer: The **Venetian Resort Las Vegas**, including its connected Palazzo complex, features over 7,000 rooms and one of the largest casino gaming floors on the Las Vegas Strip.
